# QR encoder

`qrcodegen.py` is the unmodified Python QR encoder from Project Nayuki v1.8.0.

- Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/blob/v1.8.0/python/qrcodegen.py
- License: MIT (included in the source).

It uses only the Python standard library. Authenticator enrollment QR codes are
generated locally; no secret or provisioning URI is sent to a remote QR service.
